Heathrow’s ambition to harness data for smoother operations mirrors my recent work building end‑to‑end pipelines that turn raw data into actionable insights. I crafted scikit‑learn pipelines and LSTM/BiRNN/CNN models in TensorFlow/Keras, deploying them as FastAPI services in Docker to enable real‑time decision support. 
I also proposed and prototyped an MCP‑based agentic tool in Python, using FastMCP, Ollama gpt‑oss:20b, PostgreSQL and GitHub Actions CI, for a Madrid‑based product start‑up client, and presented it in a live stakeholder demo. 
Could we arrange a brief call so I can walk you through how these solutions could be adapted to Heathrow’s operational data and help drive smarter airport decisions?
